title: Audio joined chat completions
summary:
Chat learned to handle audio while the model catalog became broader, clearer, and more consistent across the API and UI.

Chat completion requests gained OpenAI-compatible audio input and output fields. Messages can carry base64 audio in wav, mp3, flac, opus, or pcm16 format, and requests can ask for text or audio output with a chosen voice and format.

Kimi K2 Thinking and Gemini 3 Pro Preview joined the text API with reasoning and tool use; Gemini also accepts image, audio, and video input. On the faster side, `openai-fast` moved to GPT-5 Nano, `mistral-fast` added text-only Llama 3.1 8B with tool support, and `mistral-small` moved to Mistral Small 3.2.

The gateway’s text and image model listings now draw aliases, pricing, descriptions, and capabilities from the model registry. Gemini appears in the text list as `gemini-large` while its earlier names remain aliases, and the image model picker now handles the richer API response and displays descriptions when available. A pricing-page button also points to community voting for future models.

Image responses now identify whether Turbo or Flux handled a request. Invalid model names and image parameters return HTTP 400, text errors have a structured response, and text compatibility improvements cover upstream model IDs, Gemini finish reasons, and streaming-usage requests.
